# nandoc.dev

> Business Process Automation, Internal Systems & Custom Software Development based in Panama City, Panama.

## Overview
nandoc.dev is operated by Fernando Castillo Valdés, a back-end engineer and automation specialist with 10+ years of production software experience. The practice focuses on eliminating operational bottlenecks, replacing disorganized spreadsheets and paper workflows with reliable web platforms, automated approval queues, and central operational dashboards.

## Core Services
- **Business Process Automation**: Connecting sales, operations, inventory, and accounting through automated workflows.
- **Custom Internal Tools & Portals**: Purpose-built web applications, multi-role access controls, audit logs, and approval systems.
- **Systems & API Integrations**: Seamless connections via REST APIs, webhooks, and ETL pipelines for CRMs, ERPs, and billing platforms.
- **Operational Dashboards**: Real-time business intelligence and KPI tracking for fast decision-making without manual reports.

## Production Stack
- Backend: PHP / Laravel, REST APIs, Python, Node.js
- Frontend: Modern responsive HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript, Next.js, Livewire
- Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis
- Infrastructure: Cloud deployments, CI/CD, Containerization
